suggestions: Register a RequestValidationError handler so a non-integer scenario id returns the same {error:{code,message}} body as the business 4xxs.
Declare save and simulate as plain def so the synchronous sqlite3 work runs in FastAPI's threadpool instead of on the event loop.
Round percentages from the exact fraction with integer arithmetic. The current Decimal division is exact for every acceptance ratio and only becomes context-dependent for huge totals.
Mount StaticFiles only when frontend/dist/assets exists. create_app raises if frontend/dist is present and assets is not, which will matter once the SPA build lands.
